title: Sync upstream touch previews and advanced export resolution
source: CyberTimon/RapidRAW main at e90a9bba7422ed833892e4945f06da35a65470d2; RapidRoom conflict reconciliation
notes: Adds upstream pinch and pan in denoise/negative previews and places the single validated DPI control in Advanced export settings. Retains RapidRoom preset validation, DPI metadata for JPEG/PNG/TIFF and side masks, TIFF ICC and precision, output sharpening, overwrite controls, and filename tokens. Removes obsolete Android dependency downgrades without changing locked packages. Corrects surviving-finger target selection when a pinch ends over the denoise comparison divider.
